summary: The owner-proposed scalar worst-fiber bridge M=sup_b ||p_{Q3|Q'=b}||_infinity is not uniformly bounded. An explicit n=4 cap-one product family with full matrix spectrum {1,1,1,-1} has, on a positive-measure interval of b, ||p_{Q3|Q'=b}||_infinity >= (4/(3sqrt(3))) log(m/720). This refutes only the scalar worst-conditioned-core supremum route, not QFORM. The missing factor is the unnormalized scalar-fiber mass p_{Q'}(b), which must remain coupled to the curved trace before taking suprema.
